naive_dates_note: The Threads export carries 12-hour times with no zone. They are Jakarta time (Refal, 7 Oct), unlike Maudy's Threads export, which was UTC. Read that way: the first boycott reply in the data is 08:02 WIB on 6 Oct, "Kenapa delete @kahfeveryday" is 14:16 WIB, the two apology posts are 17:45 WIB, and the surge is 00:00 to 02:00 WIB on 7 Oct (01:00 to 03:00 in Malaysia). The deleted post is not in the export.
keyword_platforms_note: Threads replies and quote posts rarely repeat the brand's name ("Rasa menyesal pernah pakai brand ni"), so nothing is dropped by keyword: the labeller sets aside posts that are not about Kahf or the case (relevant = false).
